_meta.purpose: Test PURPOSE>possibility, represented_possibility_ids semantics, unexpected material, and Story-Idea concision under the Guide architecture. Each fixture ships its OWN frozen StoryGuide inline (not generated) so the possibility ids are known and assertable.

P1_purpose_without_literal.note: Purpose fulfilled by a NON-listed composition. Scale must be strong/looking_good with EMPTY represented_possibility_ids.

creative_intent.raw_text: the overwhelming scale of the Alps
creative_intent.subject: the mountains

guide.framing_summary: For this Story: make the mountains feel enormous.

observed.summary: A lone tent dwarfed to a speck at the base of a vast granite wall that fills the entire frame; the wall's top is out of shot, emphasizing immensity. No people visible.

useful_segments.why_useful: conveys overwhelming scale through the tiny tent against the wall

expected.reason: no listed possibility (no person) but purpose (enormous scale) strongly served

P2_literal_without_purpose.note: A person+mountain Moment where composition makes the PERSON dominant and fails to convey scale. Must NOT make Scale strong merely from noun overlap.

creative_intent.raw_text: the overwhelming scale of the Alps
creative_intent.subject: the mountains

guide.framing_summary: For this Story: make the mountains feel enormous.

observed.summary: A tight waist-up selfie of a hiker smiling at the camera; a mountain is visible but small and blurred in the far background. The person fills most of the frame.

events.description: close selfie, shallow depth of field

useful_segments.why_useful: a nice portrait of the hiker

expected.note: nouns (person+mountain) overlap the possibility but purpose (enormous scale) is NOT served — must not be strong on noun overlap alone

P3_alternative_expression.note: Journey purpose served by rear/side movement that is not the literal 'walking away from camera' possibility.

creative_intent.raw_text: the feeling of our journey through the Alps
creative_intent.subject: our trek

guide.framing_summary: For this Story: the feeling of moving through the Alps day after day.

dimensions.label: Forward Motion
dimensions.purpose: Convey sustained movement through the landscape.

observed.summary: A long side-tracking shot of two hikers crossing a high ridge left-to-right, packs on, the trail visibly continuing into the distance behind and ahead — strong sense of ongoing passage.

expected.note: alternative expression (lateral, not 'away from camera') still serves the journey purpose; possibility match optional

U_unexpected_material.note: A strong unexpected Moment (a dramatic storm) that maps to NO Guide dimension. Must be preserved in strengths[], not discarded; no new dimension invented.

creative_intent.raw_text: the beauty and scale of the Alps
creative_intent.subject: the mountains

guide.framing_summary: For this Story: the scale and beauty of the Alpine landscape.

dimensions.label: Alpine Light
dimensions.purpose: Capture the quality of light on the peaks.

observed.summary: A massive granite massif fills the frame under flat midday light.
A sudden violent thunderstorm rolls over the valley — black clouds, a lightning strike, sheets of rain sweeping across the slopes. Dramatic, unplanned, cinematic.

expected.note: storm is not Scale and not Light; must surface in strengths[], must NOT spawn a Guide dimension
